date_note: Daily Security (published 2026-11-26) says access failures began on 26 November; the page gives no earlier day.
title: Danawa service suspended after a security incident presumed to be an external intrusion, Daily Security reports
geo_basis: country only: the article gives no city
summary: Daily Security reports that Korean price-comparison site Danawa, run by Connectwave, suspended service after a security incident presumed to be an external intrusion. Connectwave is investigating with an external security firm and says it will restore servers in sequence. Daily Security says a leak of member data and whether ransomware was involved are not confirmed.
plain: Korean price-comparison site Danawa went down after a suspected outside intrusion. Whether member data leaked is not confirmed.
exec: A suspected intrusion took a shopping-comparison site offline; a data leak is unconfirmed.
action: Daily Security reports that Connectwave advises customers who use the same password on Danawa and other sites to change it as a precaution.

validation.note: Single publisher read (Daily Security, which credits Electronic Times for the first report).
